status: bounded instruction-model returns against pinned firmware; hardware untested

source_spans.name: engine_mask_enable
source_spans.observed_purpose: Read the engine-bank word at offset 4, then set or clear mask 2 at logical address 0x10800032 + bank according to odd or even bank parity.

source_spans.name: channel_reference_count
source_spans.observed_purpose: Count matching active channels and return the resulting count.

source_spans.name: metadata_word6c_read
source_spans.observed_purpose: Read a 32-bit word from the metadata structure at offset 0x6c.

source_spans.name: metadata_word0c_zero_test
source_spans.observed_purpose: Test whether the 32-bit metadata word at offset 0x0c is zero.

source_spans.name: metadata_state_write_selected_engines
source_spans.observed_purpose: Write a metadata state value and apply it to selected engine records at word offset 0x08.

source_spans.name: metadata_flag_read_1
source_spans.observed_purpose: For metadata indices 0..5, require a nonzero halfword at metadata offset 0xac, then return bit 3 of byte offset 0x98.

source_spans.name: metadata_flag_read_2
source_spans.observed_purpose: For metadata indices 0..5, require a nonzero halfword at metadata offset 0xac, then return bit 5 of byte offset 0x98.

source_spans.name: metadata_flag_read_3
source_spans.observed_purpose: Walk stride-0xb0 records; for type 4 with a nonzero halfword at metadata base offset 0xac (base+0xa0 plus 0x0c), subtract 50 decimal from that halfword.

source_spans.name: broadcast_mask_counter_store
source_spans.observed_purpose: Store the supplied value at fixed address 0x455214 when the selector is nonzero, otherwise store zero; semantics are unknown.

source_spans.name: global_halfword_read
source_spans.observed_purpose: Read and return a global halfword.

source_spans.name: register_pair_configuration
source_spans.observed_purpose: Configure a pair of registers from the supplied values; register semantics are unresolved.

assumptions: Fallthrough CALL links, little-endian loads and stores, low subregister behavior, and ordinary RAM are instruction-model assumptions.
The two bg.sw_1 counter write widths are alternatives, not established ISA or firmware facts.
The six-record metadata scan and byte/word offsets are taken from the byte-exact recovered disassembly.
Metadata flag fields are reported as offsets and bit positions; higher-level field meaning is unresolved.
No hardware, peripheral, interrupt, timing, or vendor application behavior is modeled.
